title: GLM-5.3-Flash on two Sparks (CSF checkpoint, or NVFP4-Spark on an image that cannot read CSF)
evidence_scope: MTP3 with native prefix caching, a 1,048,576-token context window and, for the nvfp4-spark checkpoint, the default on an image that cannot read csf, 10 GiB of KV cache per Spark in 2,048-token pages. On installer image dev-20260928-plainstatus-cuda1342-nccl2323-status033, the deployment reported 1,530,566 KV tokens (performance/records/images/dev-20260928-plainstatus-glm53-flash-tp2-20260929.md); image, video and text memory loads on that image are in performance/records/glm53-flash/installer-memory-20260929.md. On installer image dev-20261001-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on one pair passed 7 of 7 functional checks (counting, arithmetic, code, tool calls, image, thinking) and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate response, and decoded 37.7 / 107 / 97 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 2,497 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20261001-kraken-glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp2-20261001.md). On installer image dev-20261004-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on two Sparks of a four-Spark ring passed 7 of 7 functional checks and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate or failed response, and decoded 35.7 / 110 / 99 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 2,403 tokens/s, medians of two runs (performance/records/images/dev-20261004-kraken-glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp2-20261004.md). The csf checkpoint (local-inference-lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD at dec48abd33ef), which the installer installs without --checkpoint on an image whose vLLM is SIRCL's pinned build sparkring-kraken-beta-20261007-bc9ea774, with --quantization nvfp4_csf, --load-format nvfp4_csf, W4A16 decode, the draft's experts on marlin and the pair's 10 GiB of KV cache and context window, is implemented on image dev-20261009-kraken-csf-sircl032-libsircl-plugins: its installations passed the installer's 7 functional checks and its transport check (performance/records/images/dev-20261009-kraken-csf-sircl032-libsircl-plugins-installer-ring8-20261009.md, performance/records/images/dev-20261009-kraken-csf-sircl032-libsircl-plugins-installer-ring4-20261010.md) and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate, wrong or failed response (performance/records/images/dev-20261009-kraken-csf-sircl032-libsircl-plugins-csf-screens-20261010.md); not soaked. SIRCL's serve launcher served that checkpoint on one pair with the same quantization, loader and draft backend, a source overlay and this profile's KV cache, context window and environment (VLLM_B12X_MOE_FP4_FORCE_A16=0), and its check passed (spark_transport/sircl/sparkring_sircl/vllm/RUNBOOK.md, Measured results). Timings on earlier images are single runs; not serving-qualified. Its command sets --async-scheduling; its csf checkpoint runs small-M W4A16 experts with two CTAs per SM (B12X_W4A16_SMALL_M_OCCUPANCY=2), KDA prefill coalescing and the four-Spark profile's draft settings (draft tensor parallelism, probabilistic draft sampling, standard rejection). With them and with SIRCL's ring schedules for large all-reduces, all-gathers and reduce-scatters with a 64 KiB one-shot limit and 1 MiB link pieces and slot, set at the container level; an installer deployment takes them from the pair and path-4 rows of SparkRing's default SIRCL tuning table, which apply to SIRCL 0.3.1 sessions, so on images with SIRCL 0.3.0, such as 816c6d6a7e96 and af06e2727b6a, it runs without them, the csf checkpoint on SIRCL on a pair of a ring of eight, on image 816c6d6a7e96 (lock dev-20261008-kraken-csf-sircl-libsircl-cu1342-nccl2323-status034) with GPU clocks locked at 2,418 MHz, measured 15.3 / 49.7 decode steps/s at 1 / 8 streams and a time to first token of 3.80 s at 8K through the serving A/B runner (performance/records/images/dev-20261008-kraken-csf-sircl-libsircl-tp2-tp4-matrix-20261009.md); the other checkpoints run --async-scheduling unmeasured, and no installation with these settings has run.
